course_name_en: Automotive Body Technology and Lightweight Construction

learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic concept of automotive body technology in vehicle construction, as well as body styles sedan, station wagon, convertible.
Know the most important body structures: disc, plate, profile construction.
Know the calculation methodology of shear panels and frame grids.
Understand the basic concepts of stability failure, strength, and stiffness in vehicle construction.
Be able to calculate and design load-bearing structures such as side wall frames, vehicle underbody structure, and body-in-white.
Be able to make a statement about the construction method of vehicles and their body system.
Understand the fundamental body construction methods: shell technology, space frame, and hang-on parts.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of automotive body construction and definition of the body-in-white
Structural analysis, shear panel, frame grid
Torsional and bending stiffness of car bodies and their dynamic vibration behavior
Steel and aluminum as materials in automotive body construction
Passive safety and behavior of the car body in a crash
Basic concepts of joining technology, specifically punch riveting, self-piercing riveting, and spot welding
Introduction of the concepts of body tuning and profile theory
Product development process and basic concepts of design
